_rule: F4 ENFORCEMENT (bias audit 2026-07-25): parameters were once fitted to the one file blocking a gate (L1 hash3 threshold 50->48), and BOTH later blowups landed off the tuning set. A gate corpus you tuned on is not a gate. This manifest makes the split structural rather than remembered.
_contract: TUNE files may be used freely for exploration, sweeps, threshold fitting, locates, and perturbation.
GATE files are run ONLY at promotion time, by the census/goal tools, and NEVER inspected while choosing a parameter.
A promotion is judged on GATE. If a change was fitted on GATE, the promotion is void regardless of the numbers.
goal::MIN_CORPORA (dd79_text6, dd79_bin6, sil40, data.sqlite, ecoli.fastq, weights.safetensors) is a SUBSET of GATE by construction -- the mandated minimum surface must never be tunable.
Both sets deliberately span every content class present in the corpus, so neither is degenerate.

gate._note: contains all six goal::MIN_CORPORA plus one representative of each class they omit

tune._note: same class spread, disjoint files -- explore here

_known_asymmetries: debug-symbols appears only in TUNE and archive/scientific only in GATE: goal::MIN_CORPORA forced both scientific files into GATE, and there is exactly one archive and one dwarf file in the corpus. A change fitted on symbols.dwarf therefore has no GATE sibling of its class -- treat a dwarf-driven win as UNREPLICATED until the corpus grows.

This split is by FILE, not by (file x level x threads). A parameter fitted at L1 on a TUNE file and gated at L1 on GATE files is honest; reusing the same file across both roles at different levels is NOT.

sil40 (40 MiB, sha 737ae7a404c66cd83e5eb2cb..., /root/recert_20260725/corpus/sil40) is a GATE file that exists ONLY on solvency, not on the local Mac. A GATE run on the Mac is therefore INCOMPLETE by one mandated corpus, and must say so rather than silently gating on 10 of 11 files.
